intervention: One additive translation of the free-joint x coordinate, retaining orientation and all velocities; no commanded return, pose holding, contact gate or later intervention. Zero condition has no pose writes.
primary: Task success at each signed displacement, all five K, eight paired initial states.
secondary: First policy call with post-shift images: opportunity to react, not measured correction
Actual target position and pre/post-event contacts
limits: One task, one fixed policy seed, 8 initial-state clusters
Idealized instantaneous relocation, not a physical pushing actuator
Pre-event robot trajectories can differ between K; this compares complete policies, not isolated observation delay
invalid_geometry: Abort collection on new non-table penetration deeper than 1mm immediately after event; preserve failed attempt. No silent exclusion or coordinate clipping.
